integration_status.description: documented = CLI flags verified on a real install, adapter not yet written.

pinned_version.description: Exact installed version the adapter was verified against. `<command> --version` is checked before a call; a mismatch is a failed attempt (next route is tried), so an upgrade never reaches production unverified.

verified_with.description: Tool version the invocation was verified against.

prefix.description: Words placed before the command (e.g. a secret-injecting wrapper `with-secrets <name> --`); the harness itself is still `command`.

non_interactive_args.description: Argument template; {prompt}, {model}, {cwd}, {mode}, {timeout} are filled by the adapter.

model_args.description: Appended when a model is selected; {model} and {provider} are filled. Absent = the harness cannot select a model per call.

effort_args.description: Appended when an effort is selected; {effort} is filled. Absent = the harness cannot select effort per call.

auth_env.description: Names of env vars only. Values never live in Git.

capability_tools.description: Capability id -> harness-native tool names granted when the agent holds that capability.

models.description: Model identifiers verified to work with this harness.

efforts.description: Effort levels the harness accepts. Absent = not checked here (the harness validates).

cost_reporting.description: exact = harness returns cost per call; tokens = harness returns token usage, cost = tokens x pricing_usd_per_mtok; a {flat: true} pricing entry makes either kind charge 0 (the list-price cost is kept as equivalent_cost_usd); none = runtime uses config estimated_cost_usd_per_call.

pricing_usd_per_mtok.description: cost_reporting=tokens: '<provider>/<model>' (or '<provider>/*') -> {in, cache_hit, out} USD per million tokens, or {flat: true} for flat-rate or free plans: charged 0, usage still recorded. A flat entry may also carry the list prices (in/cache_hit/out) to record the equivalent cost; a claude-code flat entry uses the CLI's reported cost as the equivalent. A route without an entry falls back to the config estimate.
